jp: 今年[ことし]{の|no-possessive}宿題[しゅくだい]{は|wa-topic}、去年[きょねん]{ほど|hodo-nai}多[おお]くありません。
en: There is not as much homework this year as there was last year.
why: Noun + ほど + negative predicate means not as much as that noun.

jp: 英語[えいご]{の|no-possessive}試験[しけん]{は|wa-topic}、数学[すうがく]{の|no-possessive}試験[しけん]{ほど|hodo-nai}難[むずか]しくなかったです。
en: The English exam was not as difficult as the math exam.
why: ほど + a negative predicate sets the math exam as the higher standard.

jp: 新[あたら]しい会社[かいしゃ]{は|wa-topic}、前[まえ]{の|no-possessive}会社[かいしゃ]{ほど|hodo-nai}残業[ざんぎょう]{が/は|ga-subject}多[おお]くありません。
en: The new company does not have as much overtime as my previous one.
why: 前の会社ほど…多くない means the old company is the benchmark that the new one does not reach.

jp: 田中[たなか]さん{は|wa-topic}、先生[せんせい]{ほど|hodo-nai}漢字[かんじ]{を/は|o-object}知[し]りません。
en: Mr. Tanaka does not know as many kanji as the teacher.
why: 先生ほど…知らない compares Tanaka with the teacher, who knows more.

jp: 平日[へいじつ]{の|no-possessive}図書館[としょかん]{は|wa-topic}、土曜日[どようび]{ほど|hodo-nai}混[こ]んでいません。
en: The library on weekdays is not as crowded as on Saturdays.
why: 土曜日ほど混んでいない means Saturday is the more crowded standard.

jp: テスト{の|no-possessive}点[てん]{は|wa-topic}、期待[きたい]した{ほど|hodo-nai}よくありませんでした。
en: My test score was not as good as I had hoped.
why: 期待したほど…ない means the result fell short of what was expected.
